svg.title: Ridge shrinkage and training-validation error
svg.desc: For the centered orthogonal design with X transpose X equal to four I, slopes two and three shrink by four divided by four plus lambda. At penalties zero, four, twelve, thirty-six, validation MSE is nine,3.25,2.8125,3.33. Training error rises; strong shrinkage does not guarantee better validation. Purple dashed error line is the predict-zero baseline four. Continuous curves illustrate the constructed loss; the tuning grid contains four values.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(98%,98%,96%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Shrink the fit; check what improves
Constructed cases. Loss: SSE + lambda times squared slopes.
